description.value: Cape Carraholly Retreat is a boat-access-only oceanfront sanctuary on 75 acres along the Burrard Inlet, reached by a complimentary boat shuttle from Rocky Point Park in Port Moody. Just 14 km from Vancouver, the property offers four three-bedroom lodges, five yurts, and a dome, each with a fire pit and hot tub, alongside shared amenities including a dry sauna, kayaks, and a beach shack. It borders Belcarra Regional Park, giving guests direct trail access — though the boat-only entry means touring cyclists must transport their bikes by boat.
